Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long, ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, sh As Object, s As String, v As String, failure As Long

    Select Case which
    Case 1, 36, 37, 38, 39, 40, 41, 132, 133, 134, 135, 136, 137: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddTextbox(1, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case Else: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(1, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    End Select
    Select Case which \ 60
    Case 0: Act0 which, sh, failure
    Case 1: Act1 which, sh, failure
    Case 2: Act2 which, sh, failure

    s = IIf(failure = 0, "ok", "Err " & failure)
    On Error Resume Next
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.TextFrame2.TextRange.Font.Fill.Visible
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "~" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.TextFrame2.TextRange.Font.Fill.Type
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "~" & v
    Err.Clear
